text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? Ah... I had quite
an enjoyable time yesterday, you see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Sharing a luncheon with close companions
is truly a delightful affair.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Does she mean Dream Journey, Gold Ship,
and Nakayama Festa?
I often see her hanging out with them.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... Shall we all go out to eat together again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre seemed to have had a wonderful day off,
enjoying delicious food with close friends.
